verdict.rationale: MoonPay's off-ramp product (docs-17, docs-3) lets crypto be converted to cash paid to a bank account or card, and this can be built into a business's own flow via APIs/webhooks (docs-11, docs-14). However, this is framed as a consumer/end-user cash-out feature, not a documented merchant treasury/settlement product for automatically converting incoming stablecoin payments into a fiat balance so a business's books never hold crypto. Missing for 10: explicit merchant/business settlement documentation, stablecoin-specific auto-conversion mechanics, fiat balance/ledger concept, and accounting-oriented guarantees that crypto is never held.
